title: Bitcoin Came THIS Close to Breaking Down: $97K Next?
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: The AI trade has been collapsing and the Nasdaq drawdown weighs on Bitcoin, which has held up relatively well.

calls.condition: Break above 87,200 targets 95-97k by around late November; a daily close below 81,000 breaks the bullish consolidation, where he would buy 25% near 75.5k and load the rest around 67k (60-70k zone).
calls.reason: Stuck in a ~6k range between 81k and 87.2k; rising trendline, measured move and pivot projection converge at 96-97k; higher high after lower highs means the bear-market low is in until proven otherwise.
calls.quote: I literally have no position on a swing trade basis in Bitcoin long or short.

calls.condition: Break of support likely sends ETH below 2,000 where he will be a heavy buyer; break above resistance should retest 2,800.
calls.reason: Held key support and key resistance, now range-bound between them.
calls.quote: I will be a heavy buyer just below 2,000 right there.

calls.reason: Broke out of resistance and retraced to 'the scene of the crime' (retest of breakout as support); expects a ~20%+ bounce.
calls.quote: I'll probably look for about 10 cents right back to here on this which would be a nice little basically 20% plus gainer on H bar.

notes: BTC dipped to ~79,750 'today' before recovering above 81k; no explicit current price. HBAR picked up 'yesterday' with members; entry price not stated (implied ~0.083 from 20% to 0.10). Medium-term BTC target 97k is conditional on breaking 87.2k.
